info.title: LLM Bootstrap experiment protocol schemas
info.description:
Machine-readable core of references/experiment-protocol.md. This document defines no HTTP operations; the Schema Objects under components.schemas are the deliverable. Validate experiments/<experiment-id>/experiment.json against Experiment, or against DerivedExperiment before resolving it (scripts/resolve-experiment.mjs) and validating the result as Experiment, with any JSON Schema 2020-12 validator.

Every field is a top-level key whose value is a scalar or an array of strings. There are no nested objects: a group is a key prefix (hardware_, target_, builder_, harness_, evaluation_, implementation_, baseline, goal_, budget_), a list of pairs is an array of name=value strings, and a conditional declaration is a string that starts with 'Not applicable: ' or 'Unavailable: ' and gives the reason.

The report of each evaluation is a separate document, experiments/<experiment-id>/evaluation/<subject>/<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.json, defined by EvaluationReport in evaluation-protocol.openapi.json. An experiment only selects a repository-owned evaluation by reference.

The prose protocol and the skills remain authoritative. A passing validation shows only that a document has the required shape. It is not evidence of correct measurements, a followed procedure, SOTA performance, autonomy, or self-hosting.

Unresolved draft fields are null. An experiment with status frozen forbids null in any field.

GitCommitSha.description: Full 40-character Git commit SHA. Abbreviated SHAs, branches, and tags are not immutable revisions.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with an explicit UTC offset.

NotApplicable.description: Explicit declaration that a field does not apply, as text that gives the reason.

Unavailable.description: A provider or historical detail that cannot be obtained, as text that gives the reason. Never substitute a fabricated identifier.

NotObtained.description: Marker for a metric that was not measured. A missing metric is never zero.

Digest.description: A named file, executable, kernel, or image with its content hash, written name=sha256.

EngineRevision.description: A baseline engine with the full commit that was evaluated, written name=commit.

Threshold.description: A threshold on a headline metric of the evaluation report (decode_tokens_per_second_p50, speed_ttft_ms_p50, and the others the evaluation protocol lists), written 'metric >= value' or 'metric <= value'. Units are those of the metric name.

NumberOrNotApplicable.description: A non-negative number, a not-applicable declaration, or null while the experiment is a draft.

ComparisonTrack.description: A matched-configuration track compares engines at matched precision, workload, caching, speculation, and resources. A best-permitted-configuration track compares complete systems inside a fixed quality and resource envelope, disclosing every difference.

NoNullFields.description: An object none of whose fields is null. Used to require that a frozen experiment has no unresolved field.

Experiment.description: The experiment, frozen before implementation. A draft keeps unresolved fields as null; status frozen requires every field to be resolved or declared not applicable. A submitted experiment.json is never edited; an amendment is a new experiment that names the amended revision and the reason.

experiment_id.description: Equals the directory name under experiments/.

skills_revision.description: Full commit of the skill repository supplied to the builder. A later skill revision defines a new treatment.

builder_instruction_sha256.description: Hashes of the exact instruction files provided to the builder, as path=sha256.

amends_revision.description: Full commit of the experiment this one amends.

scope.description: What the experiment covers, which operating-system changes are permitted (none is a valid statement), and the user authorization that governs execution. Plugin installation authorizes nothing.

target_files.description: Hashes of the weight files, as name=sha256.

target_weights.description: Quantization method and group size with weight precision.

target_speculative_draft.description: Draft model identity and settings. Required unless speculative decoding is disabled; then 'Not applicable: reason'.

builder_revision.description: The provider-exposed revision or identifier, or 'Unavailable: reason'.

builder_inference_location.description: Where the builder's initial inference runs.

harness_name.description: The harness that drives engine development. Keep it distinct from the evaluation driver even when both use the same product.

harness_revision.description: Revision or package hash, or 'Unavailable: reason'.

evaluation_id.description: A repository-owned evaluation. Its code, scripts, dataset, tasks, and limits cannot be set or changed here.

evaluation_revision.description: LLM Bootstrap repository commit of the evaluation. Null only while the experiment is a draft.

evaluation_sha256.description: Hash of the evaluation definition file at that commit.

implementation_starting_scaffold.description: Starting engine or scaffold with its revision, and any permitted code reuse.

implementation_allowed_libraries.description: An empty array means no third-party implementation dependency is allowed.

implementation_existing_engine_backend_a.description: Wrapping a baseline engine does not demonstrate building an inference backend.

baseline_selection_method.description: How the candidate set was chosen from dated primary sources, and which plausible alternatives could not be evaluated.

baseline_engines.description: Baseline engines with the evaluated commit, as name=commit. A frozen experiment names at least one.

goal_primary_metric.description: Define which metric competitive refers to before tuning, including timing boundaries. Native command-level metrics are not interchangeable with N-1 interval metrics.

goal_thresholds.description: Acceptance thresholds on headline metrics of the evaluation report, such as 'decode_tokens_per_second_p50 >= 100' or 'speed_ttft_ms_p50 <= 500'. Resource limits the evaluation cannot measure are stated in scope or the stopping rule instead. Relaxing them silently to pass is not allowed.

goal_quality_gate.description: Correctness gates and permitted quality loss.

budget_api_cost_limit.description: Amount with currency, or 'Not applicable: reason'.

DerivedExperiment.description: An experiment that inherits a base experiment and overrides some of its fields. Because the document is flat, an override is a field of the same name, which replaces the base value. Resolve it (scripts/resolve-experiment.mjs), then validate the result as Experiment. The target model cannot be overridden, so a derived experiment always runs the base's target model; a different model needs a new base experiment. This schema checks the envelope only. Unknown or misspelled override fields are rejected when the effective experiment is validated.

extends_path.description: The base experiment.json, relative to this file. The base may itself be derived.
